item.title: TTT 398: Ladies Vs. Gentlemen
item.description:
It’s a battle of the sexes and Eric started it because he can’t keep his mouth shut. It was a nice woman-friendly episode until Eric ruined the end of it with something gross. That sure deserves a punch to the face while sleeping.

Calgary’s Only Podcast!

  • Escort - Actor Out Of Work
  • Blood Moon - Ghost

item.title: TTT 395: Call And Response
item.description:
Lots going on in this episode.

Rachelle’s night out / Eric wants to know “Who are you?” / Child interruptions / Is tipping out of control? / People need to get a handle on their dogs / Pepsi dealers in our backyard

We are Calgary’s only podcast!

  • Sylvie Vartan - Irresistiblement
  • The Dears - Lost In The Plot

item.title: TTT 391: Shove It In Your Face!
item.description:
Eric & Rachelle LOVE to put stuff in their mouths. In fact, we spend a good part of the episode talking about just that. You know we’re talking about food, right?

Calgary’s most delicious podcast!

Music

  • Koji Nakamura - I Know
  • Bruce Springsteen - My Love Will Not Let You Down

item.title: TTT 388: Hot Tubbin'
item.description:
Both Rachelle and Eric agree that the measure of success is how many hot tubs you have. Just try and dispute us. You can’t.

We are Calgary’s only podcast.

Music

  • The Plimsouls - Playing With Jack
  • Nimmo and the Gauntletts - Jaded

item.title: TTT 386: Personal Opinions
item.description:
We have a lot of opinions — mostly dumb. We let our charm cover up our clear lack of authority on any given subject. Hear us cast opinions on “tasteful erotic nudes”, sororities, and smartphone apps. Calgary’s only podcast!

Music

  • Hightime Rebellion - Sail
  • Speak - Gates

item.title: TTT 385: Nous Ne Somme Pas Des Anges
item.description:
Back in the studio after the last episode from the car. In this episode we discuss Twins, Rats, and more twins. Also, flyers and creative opportunities of Craigslist. Calgary’s only podcast.

Music

  • France Gall - Nous Ne Somme Pas Des Anges
  • Dues - Game & Performance

item.title: TTT 337: A Nerd Is A Nerd Is A Nerd
item.description:
Eric hates everything; Stupid wars, naked yoga, instagram nerds, and gun nuts. Rachelle hates it when Eric just won’t start the clip and sees the need to be all professional and stuff. After 300 plus episodes you’d think that wouldn’t be an issue but it still is.

Still the best podcast in Calgary. What the fuck?!
